final: WITH project_ratios AS (SELECT p.arcregistry, p.fundflux, SUM(s.boxx) / NULLIF(SUM(s.boxz), 0) AS ratio FROM projects AS p JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux), scored AS (SELECT arcregistry, fundflux, ratio, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY fundflux) AS excess FROM project_ratios) SELECT arcregistry AS project_id, fundflux AS funding_source, ratio, excess FROM scored ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
